title: Easy Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich, airy chocolate mousse made by folding whipped cream into melted dark chocolate. No raw eggs and just four ingredients.

image.alt: Three small glasses of chocolate mousse with whipped cream

steps.text: Warm {qty 1/2 cup} of the cream until steaming and pour it over the chocolate in the heatproof bowl. Let it sit for {time 2 min}, then stir until smooth. Cool to lukewarm, {time 10 min}.
Whip the remaining cold cream with the sugar, vanilla and salt to soft peaks that just hold their shape.
Stir a third of the whipped cream into the chocolate to lighten it, then gently fold in the rest until no streaks remain.
Spoon into glasses and chill until set, at least {time 2 hr notimer}.

notes: If the chocolate is too warm it will melt the cream; if too cold it will seize into flecks. Lukewarm is just right.
